- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:263-285 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Echo statement changed from "AUTOFIX_GATE_CLAUDE_BRANCH_REVIEW pr=${PR_NUMBER} head_ref=..." to "AUTOFIX_GATE_CLAUDE_BRANCH_REVIEW_NO_PR head_ref=...", dropping the pr=${PR_NUMBER} (even if empty) reference.
  WHY: Minor observability gap — gate logs for no-PR claude-branch pushes lose the PR-number context (useful when correlating with upstream internal-review.yml logs during stall recovery or manual debugging); no functional impact, but harder to trace across logs without manual ref_name → PR lookup.
- .github/workflows/internal-review.yml:33-52 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Concurrency group key uses github.head_ref || github.ref_name without explicit handling for pull_request.targeted events (fires on label changes without SHA update).
  WHY: Unlikely race if targeted fires concurrently with push/synchronize on same head_ref — could cancel wrong run (targeted reviews labels on prior SHA, push reviews new SHA); low risk as targeted doesn't advance SHA and claude/** pushes are now no-cancel on PR events.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
